titles.en: Koumei who Stands in Opposition, the Freeing of Rikuson the Crimson at Koutou
titles.ja: 在野の孔明, 深紅の陸遜を江東に放つ

titles.en: Rikuson at a Loss, his Discovery of Sonken in Go`s Capital
titles.ja: 彷徨える陸遜, 呉の都に孫権を見出す

titles.en: Assemble at Koutou`s lands, young patriots
titles.ja: 若き志士ども, 江東の大地に集結す

titles.en: The one-eyed hero entrusts Ryoutou with the principles of a warrior
titles.ja: 隻眼の勇者, 戦士の道を凌統に託す

titles.en: A grieving Ryoutou roars in agony as he hunts down a bitter enemy
titles.ja: 嘆きの凌統, 仇敵を求めて咆哮す

titles.en: In his sorrow, Kannei of Suzu shoots an arrow into the battlefield
titles.ja: 鈴の甘寧, 悲しき一矢を戦場に射る

titles.en: A bewildered Rikuson sees the light in a reunion with his teacher
titles.ja: 惑いし陸遜, 師との再会に光を見る

titles.en: Shokatsuryou Koumei inspires Sonken of Go with his idea
titles.ja: 諸葛孔明, 論を以て呉の孫権を動かす

titles.en: The young warriors assemble at Koutou`s hills and rivers for training
titles.ja: 若武者集いて, 江東の山河に己を磨く

titles.en: Sou Moutoku pushes a red wall, drawing near Son Go
titles.ja: 曹孟徳, 赤き壁を駆りて孫呉へ迫る

titles.en: Go`s Six Steeds cause the dawn over Choukou to gleam red
titles.ja: 呉の六駿, 夜明けの長江に紅く煌く

titles.en: Ingenuity and cunning, the sound of the ominous flute reverberates across the lake shore
titles.ja: 知略と鬼略, 妖しき笛の音湖畔に木霊す

titles.en: Bi Shuurou stands upon the battlefield to guide Rikuson
titles.ja: 美周郎, 戦野に立ちて陸遜を導く

titles.en: The wail of Son Go wavers from repose offered by the Six Steeds
titles.ja: 孫呉の慟哭, 六駿鎮魂に揺らめく

titles.en: Gloomy Rikuson vows to recover with Sonken`s smile
titles.ja: 憂いし陸遜, 孫権の微笑に再起を誓す

titles.en: Kan`u`s roar strikes Rikuson which forces him to hold determination
titles.ja: 関羽の咆哮, 陸遜を撃ちて覚悟を迫る

titles.en: reunion at the thatched hut, the deep connection between masted and disciple, wedged together in Ekishuu
titles.ja: 草庵の再会, 師弟の深縁益州に交叉す

titles.en: The sworn brothers of the peach garden see the flower of ties in the fields and mountains of Shoku
titles.ja: 桃園の義兄弟, 蜀の山野にて絆の花を見る

titles.en: Courageous Taishiji stands tall on the earth of the Central Plains
titles.ja: 猛き太史慈, 中原の大地に仁王立つ

titles.en: Amou of Go rises from obscurity by using his young wisdom
titles.ja: 呉下の阿蒙, 若き智を用いてその身を起こす

titles.en: Kouryou`s setting sun seiyes a warrior`s soul
titles.ja: 江陵の落日, 武人の魂を侵奪す

titles.en: Ryuubi goes insane and becomes a frozen shadow, wandering in Koutou
titles.ja: 劉備乱心, 凍てつく陰となりて江東を彷徨う

titles.en: Son Chuubou, in the snowfield, follows Rikuson to escape from his homeland
titles.ja: 雪原の孫仲謀, 陸遜に従いて故国を脱す

titles.en: Ryuubi`s weeping gives a new light to the field
titles.ja: 劉備の落涙, 新たな光明を野に示す

titles.en: Riku Hakugen dances on Gojougen where red stars are falling
titles.ja: 陸伯言, 紅き星落つ五丈原に舞う

titles.en: Crimson Soul, Dispatch the Living Patriot
titles.ja: 深紅の魂, 生ける志士どもを走らす
titles.x-jat: Shinkou no Tamashii, Ikeru Shishi-domo o Hashirasu
